raw_title: The Informed Citizen in Local Communities: A User-Centred Study on How the Public Values Local Journalism
title_en: The Informed Citizen in Local Communities: A User-Centred Study on How the Public Values Local Journalism
title_zh: The Informed Citizen in Local Communities: A User-Centred Study on How the Public Values Local Journalism
plain_summary_en: This paper studies The Informed Citizen in Local Communities: A User-Centred Study on How the Public Values Local Journalism. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is local news, public value, informed citizens, user-centered design. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
